pieces.h: Exam Details
pieces.t: The Virginia Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation Board for Contractors regulates individual tradesmen in electrical, plumbing, HVAC, gas fitting, and other trades. For Virginia tradesman licensing exams, candidates apply for eligibility through the Board before testing, and PSI administers the examination program. The exam is administered by computer, with one question displayed at a time and a score report provided after the exam. The Virginia Journeyman Electrician exam is a trade licensing exam designed to confirm that candidates have the minimum required knowledge of electrical principles, practices, statutes, and regulations. Electrical exam preparation should include both code-based review and practical trade knowledge. Candidates should be ready for questions involving NEC application, electrical theory, wiring and protection, wiring methods, conductors, grounding and bonding, equipment, motors, calculations, and safe installation practices.

pieces.h: Exam Details
pieces.t: PSI’s Virginia examination information states that individual examination content outlines identify the time limit, minimum score required to pass, subject areas, item counts, and reference materials used to prepare questions. Candidates should use the current outline for the exact Virginia Journeyman Electrician exam they are approved to take. This Ultimate Combo supports the preparation process by giving students organized study guides, code book practice, calculation review, flash cards, online questions, course access, and application service support.

pieces.h: Open Book Test
pieces.t: The Virginia tradesman examination rules allow candidates to bring reference books. Study guides and sample examinations are not allowed in the exam room. Reference books may be highlighted, underlined, and indexed before the exam, but they must otherwise be unmarked and not written in. This makes preparation with the correct reference material and clean code navigation habits especially important. Open-book testing does not mean the exam is easy. It means candidates must know how to locate information quickly, understand what the question is asking, and apply the correct rule under time pressure. A candidate who has not practiced with the code book may spend too much time searching and not enough time answering. The National Electrical Code 2026 Paperback with Tabs included in this combo helps students practice finding articles, tables, definitions, exceptions, and common electrical rules before exam day. The best open-book preparation includes repeated code lookup practice.

pieces.h: Open Book Test
pieces.t: Students should learn the structure of the NEC, become familiar with commonly tested articles, and practice moving from a question to the correct code section. The included study guides, flash cards, and online test success kit help reinforce that process by combining written review, quick recall, and practice-oriented question work.

pieces.h: Licensing Steps
pieces.t: Virginia journeyman electrician candidates begin by reviewing the current tradesman application instructions and confirming that their education and work experience meet the Board for Contractors requirements. The Board approves applications for testing, and candidates must receive eligibility before scheduling the exam. Eligibility is issued through the licensing process and is used when registering for the examination. A practical path begins with gathering experience documentation, training records, and any required application materials. Candidates then submit the Virginia tradesman exam and license application for the electrical classification. After the Board approves the application, the candidate registers for the examination through PSI and selects an available testing option. PSI provides computer-based testing procedures, score reporting, and scheduling support. After passing the exam, candidates complete the remaining licensing steps required by Virginia.

pieces.h: Licensing Steps
pieces.t: Candidates should also keep renewal requirements in mind after licensure, including continuing education obligations for active journeyman and master tradesman licenses. pieces.t: Virginia regulates individual tradesmen through the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation Board for Contractors. Electrical tradesmen must hold the appropriate credential before performing regulated electrical work in the Commonwealth. The state’s tradesman licensing structure includes electrical licensing, and candidates must satisfy the Board’s education, experience, application, examination, and licensing requirements. Virginia’s tradesman application process requires candidates to use the correct application for individuals seeking electrical, plumbing, HVAC, or gas fitting licensure. The application process is separate from business contractor licensing. A journeyman electrician candidate should focus on the individual tradesman license requirements, not a contractor business license, unless they are also pursuing a separate contractor license for a business entity. Electrical candidates should also be aware that local ordinances or other requirements may apply depending on where they plan to work.

pieces.t: Virginia journeyman electrician exam preparation should include both technical knowledge and code-navigation practice. pieces.h: Test Information and Study Materials
pieces.t: A strong study plan should include scheduled review time, repeated NEC lookup practice, calculation drills, and question review. Candidates should avoid relying only on memorization. Many electrical exam questions require applying a rule, reading a table correctly, identifying the right article, or recognizing when a special condition changes the general requirement. Studying with both printed and online materials gives candidates more ways to reinforce the same knowledge. For open-book practice, students should work directly from the NEC instead of only reading summaries. Practice locating definitions, reviewing article scope statements, using tables, and reading exceptions carefully. For calculation practice, students should write out the steps, identify the known values, choose the correct formula or code table, and check the answer for reasonableness. These habits can make study sessions more productive and help build exam-day confidence.

pieces.h: Q: What topics are covered on the Virginia Master Electrician exam?
pieces.t: The outline includes Virginia regulatory topics and electrical trade topics such as electrical installations, electrical fundamentals, services, feeders, branch circuits, grounding and bonding, conductors, raceways, motors, controls, utilization equipment, lighting, low voltage requirements, communication systems, and fire detection and alarm systems.

pieces.h: Q: Why is an electrician calculations study guide included?
pieces.t: Electrical calculations are an important part of electrician exam preparation. A dedicated calculations guide helps students practice formulas, problem setup, math accuracy, and code-based calculation methods.

pieces.h: Q: Why is the National Electrical Code 2026 paperback included?
pieces.t: The NEC is a key electrical reference for code study and professional electrical work. The 2026 NEC paperback helps students review code language, article organization, installation requirements, and code navigation.

pieces.h: Q: Who administers the Virginia Master Electrician exam?
pieces.t: The Virginia tradesman examinations are administered through PSI for the Commonwealth of Virginia Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation.

pieces.h: Q: Do I need approval before scheduling the Virginia Master Electrician exam?
pieces.t: Yes. Virginia DPOR states that pre-approval from the Board is required to sit for tradesman examinations. After approval, candidates schedule the exam through PSI.

pieces.h: Q: Is this combo only for Virginia Master Electrician exam preparation?
pieces.t: This combo is built around Virginia Master Electrician preparation, but the calculations guide and National Electrical Code 2026 paperback can also support broader electrical study and code review.

pieces.h: Q: How should I study with this combo?
pieces.t: Start with the Virginia Master Electrician Study Guide to organize the exam topics, use the NEC paperback to practice code navigation, and work through the Electrician Calculations Study Guide regularly to strengthen math-based problem solving.

pieces.h: Exam Room Approved Books
pieces.t:
National Electrical Code
The National Electrical Code is listed as an electrician reference for Virginia electrical examinations. Candidates should use the code edition identified by the current Virginia PSI candidate bulletin for the exam they are scheduled to take.
American Electricians’ Handbook
The American Electricians’ Handbook is listed as an electrician reference in the Virginia PSI candidate bulletin and supports general electrical knowledge, trade fundamentals, and practical electrical subject review.
Virginia Board for Contractors Individual License and Certification Regulations
This regulatory reference applies to Virginia tradesman examinations and supports review of standards of practice, standards of conduct, renewal, reinstatement, definitions, qualification for licensure, and revocation topics.

pieces.h: Q: Who is this Virginia Master Electrician exam prep combo for?
pieces.t: This combo is for electricians preparing for the Virginia Master Electrician licensing exam administered through PSI after approval by the Virginia Board for Contractors.

pieces.h: Q: Is this product based on the 2026 National Electrical Code?
pieces.t: Yes. This product is based on the 2026 National Electrical Code and is designed to support NEC-focused electrical exam preparation.

pieces.h: Q: Who regulates Virginia Master Electrician licensing?
pieces.t: Virginia Master Electrician licensing is regulated by the Virginia Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation through the Board for Contractors.

pieces.h: Q: How much time is allowed for the Virginia Master Electrician exam?
pieces.t: The Virginia Master Electrician examination allows 270 minutes for completion.

pieces.h: Q: What score is required to pass the Virginia Master Electrician exam?
pieces.t: The passing score is 63 correct answers out of 90, which equals 70%.

pieces.h: Q: What references are used for the Virginia Master Electrician exam?
pieces.t: The Virginia electrician examination references include the National Electrical Code, American Electricians’ Handbook, and Virginia Board for Contractors Individual License and Certification Regulations. Candidates should use the exact editions required for the scheduled exam.

pieces.h: Q: Can I write in my books during the Virginia exam?
pieces.t: No. Candidates may not write in reference materials during the examination. References may be highlighted, underlined, and indexed before the exam, but reference materials containing writing are not allowed.

pieces.h: Q: Are removable tabs allowed for the Virginia exam?
pieces.t: No. Virginia exam rules allow permanent tabs only. Removable tabs are not allowed.

pieces.h: Q: Does this product include practice exams?
pieces.t: Yes. This package includes 12 practice exams plus 2 full final exams. The practice exams help you build familiarity with exam-style questions, while the final exams help you evaluate readiness after completing more of your study plan.

pieces.h: Q: Are flash cards included?
pieces.t: Yes. This is a study guide and flash card combo. The flash cards are designed to help reinforce electrical terms, formulas, definitions, NEC concepts, Virginia licensing topics, calculations, and exam-style recall.

pieces.h: Q: Does this combo guarantee that I will pass the exam?
pieces.t: No. This product is designed to support preparation through structured study, practice exams, final exams, flash card review, reference navigation, and NEC-based preparation. Exam results and licensing approval depend on the candidate’s preparation, testing performance, and Virginia licensing requirements.
